feeds.title: Microbe Notes
feeds.description: Microbe Notes is an educational niche blog/website related to microbiology (bacteriology, virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, etc.) and different branches of biology with an aim to provide study notes to undergraduate and graduate students. This website is also useful for A-level biology, AP biology, IB biology, and other university-level biology and microbiology courses (B.Sc, M.Sc., M.Phil., and Ph.D.).

feeds.title: Rapid microbiology

feeds.title: Microbial Notes
feeds.description: Microbial Notes are a type of scientific record that document the characteristics and behavior of microorganisms. These notes can be used for a variety of purposes, including studying the effects of different environmental conditions on microbe growth and identifying potential pathogens.

feeds.title: FEMS Blog
feeds.description: The Federation of European Microbiological Societies (FEMS) blog highlights the fascinating aspects of all things microbiology. The blog presents recent microbiology papers, gives a voice to members of the FEMS community, shares lesser-known facts about the history of microbiology, covers events, and meetings, and highlights the global relevance of microbiology, microbes, and more.

feeds.title: Medical Microbiology
feeds.description: Journal of Medical Microbiology is the go-to interdisciplinary journal for medical, dental and veterinary microbiology, at the bench and in the clinic. It provides comprehensive coverage of medical, dental and veterinary microbiology and infectious diseases, welcoming articles ranging from laboratory research to clinical trials, including bacteriology, virology, mycology and parasitology

feeds.title: Microbial Genomics
feeds.description: Bases to Biology

feeds.title: MICROBIOLOGY MATTERS !
feeds.description: This is a website which is designed to be a resource site for people interested in microbiology, and in particular those who have or are pursuing a career in any aspect of microbiology, including bacteriology, mycology, virology and molecular biology. Authored by Michael Addidle.

feeds.title: The RMM Blog - Rapid Microbiology and Rapid Microbiological Methods
feeds.description: Updated routinely by Dr. Michael J. Miller, our RMM blog will keep you informed of new and noteworthy technologies, reviews of recent publications and presentations, upcoming conferences and training events, and what's changing in the RMM world.

feeds.title: American Society for Microbiology
feeds.description: The American Society for Microbiology (ASM) is the oldest and largest single life science membership organization in the world. Membership has grown from 59 scientists in 1899 to more than 39,000 members today, with more than one-third located outside the United States. The mission of the ASM is to promote understanding of the central role of microbes on our planet and to apply and communicate this knowledge for the improvement of global health and the environment.

feeds.title: Microbiology and Cell Biology, Medicinal Chemistry Emery Pharma Blog
feeds.description: Emery Pharma Services was created to provide state-of-the-art Analytical Chemistry & Biology services to everyday organic chemists and medicinal scientists.

feeds.title: Microbiology Notes
feeds.description: Hello Everyone my self Vivek Kumar, I completed my M.Sc in microbiology from Bangalore University, India. and currently, I m doing Job in Australian laboratory services as a food microbiologist. Microbiology Notes covers basic microbiology, Immunology, molecular biology, Genetics Instrumentation, Medical microbiology, Agricultural microbiology, and Food microbiology.

feeds.title: Lablogatory Blog
feeds.description: Lablogatory is a blog for medical laboratory professionals. It's dedicated to helping phlebotomists, clinical laboratory scientists, pathology residents, and pathologists perform their jobs better. We'll have information on new technologies, posts by lab professionals working in the field, and polls to gauge your opinion on various topics. The articles include information about molecular biology, microbiology, pathology, case studies, and transfusion medicine.

feeds.title: Joyful Microbe Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about the microbial world through fun and simple online resources. Topics covered include bacteria, fungi, protozoa, algae, viruses, archaea, being a microbiologist, and science communication.

feeds.title: Ask Microbiology Blog
feeds.description: A community builds exclusively for Microbiologists. Ask Microbiology is a platform where microbiologists can interact with each other and ask questions, provide answers, post their articles, and much more stuff.

feeds.title: Small Things Considered
feeds.description: Welcome to Small Things Considered! The purpose of this blog is to share our appreciation for the width and depth of the microbial activities on this planet. We will emphasize the unusual and the unexpected phenomena for which we have a special fascination.

feeds.title: Jonathan Eisen's Lab Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jonathan Eisen. I am an evolutionary biologist and a Professor at U. C. Davis. My research focuses on the origin of novelty (how new processes and functions originate). To study this I focus on sequencing and analyzing genomes of organisms, especially microbes, and using phylogenomic analysis

feeds.title: The microBEnet The microbiology of the Built Environment network. Blog
feeds.description: At the interface of microbial ecology and building science. microBEnet is the online destination for resources related to the microbiology of the built environment. We are funded by a grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation to Jonathan Eisen at the University of California, Davis.

feeds.title: Bacteria World Blog
feeds.description: Explore the bacterial world from scientific studies to vivid and colourful articles and engaging stories for everyone. Learn about the bacterial world with engaging articles.

feeds.title: Learn Microbiology Online
feeds.description: I am Tankeshwar Acharya. I am as working as an Assistant Professor and Microbiologist at the Department of Microbiology and Immunology, Patan Academy of Health Sciences, Lalitpur, Nepal. Microbeonline.com is an online guidebook of Microbiology, precisely speaking, Medical Microbiology. In this blog, I am/ will be sharing information and resources about pathogenic bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites. I am trying my best to make this site user-friendly and resourceful with timely/updated information about each pathogen, disease caused by them, pathogenesis, and laboratory diagnosis.

feeds.title: The MicroscopeMaster Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Microscopemaster - your micro-resource! Enjoy our articles on cell biology, the microbiology of our environment, experiments, all types of techniques and applications as well as up-to-date microscopy news to expand your knowledge.

feeds.title: MicroMedEd
feeds.description: This is a weekly blog initiative aimed at providing explanations of key microbiological concepts, advances, and terms to help clinicians, scientists, students, and the public better engage with microbial science. I hope you find these resources useful and enjoy interacting with the clinical microbiology and pathology community on this blog.

feeds.title: Microbe Stew
feeds.description: Blog by Stewart Barker, a Biology Graduate, discussing Microbiology and Science!

feeds.title: Microbiology Specialists Blog
feeds.description: Blog topics cover bacterial vaginosis, clinical microbiology, Lactobacillus, microbiology, Mobiluncus, and Gut bacteria. Microbiology Specialists is a clinical and environmental testing, training, and consulting lab that serves hospitals, pharmacies, zoos, and research facilities.

feeds.title: JMM Case Reports
feeds.description: Dedicated to original case reports and furthering education in medical microbiology.

feeds.title: All Creatures Great AND Small: Preaching Microbial Supremacy!
feeds.description: Ruminations on the teaching of and research in microbiology at a small liberal arts undergraduate institution.

feeds.title: Microbiologics Blog Where Microbiologists Go To Grow
feeds.description: The Microbiologics Blog was created as an educational hub where our fellow microbiologists can find current and useful information about industry news, technical tips and advice, as well as fun and fascinating content microbiologists can relate to and learn from. Our mission is to provide the highest quality biomaterials for a safer, healthier world.

feeds.title: Microbiology : nature.com
feeds.description: Latest microbiology news and research from Nature.com

feeds.title: Pharmaceutical Microbiology Resources
feeds.description: Pharmaceutical Microbiology provides a topical overview of microbiology related news, opinion, theories and facts. The blog details the latest microbiology news, training, updates to international standards, GMP and regulatory compliance, book reviews and so on.

feeds.title: The Phage blog
feeds.description: The online hub for bacteriophage-related news, opportunities, experiments, therapy, and many more. Find the latest news and information about bacteria-killing viruses called phages, also known as bacteriophages or simply 'phages'.

feeds.title: The Microbial Menagerie
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jennifer. I am a microbiologist, science communicator, and photographer. The Microbial Menagerie began one day as I pondered about my niche in the microbiology research community. As a graduate student and a postdoctoral researcher, it is easy to get caught up in the intricacies of your own research without, diving deep into one topic, while sacrificing breadth in the general field. I created this blog in order to both educate myself in a variety of microbiology topics and bring attention to how microbiology affects our lives in ways we may not have thought about before.

feeds.title: Microcosm
feeds.description: A window into the laboratory, a glimpse of a world in miniature
